requirements.quote: When completing the Request for Waiver Form (SRAA – 5010) please check all boxes that apply.
requirements.text: Complete the Request for Waiver Form (SRAA – 5010) and check all applicable boxes.

requirements.quote: To be considered, the Request for Waiver Form must be accompanied by documentation for items 1 – 11, as listed below.
requirements.text: Submit the Request for Waiver Form with documentation for items 1-11.

requirements.quote: 1. A statement setting forth your basis for requesting a partial or total waiver.
requirements.text: Provide a statement explaining the basis for requesting a waiver.

requirements.quote: 2. The names of general circulation, trade association, and M/WBE-oriented publications in which you solicited certified M/WBEs for the purposes of complying with your participation goals.
requirements.text: List the publications used to solicit certified M/WBEs.

requirements.quote: 3. A list identifying the date(s) that all solicitations for certified M/WBE participation were published in any of the above publications.
requirements.text: Provide dates of solicitations for certified M/WBE participation.

requirements.quote: 4. A list of all certified M/WBEs appearing in the NYS Directory of Certified Firms that were solicited for purposes of complying with your certified M/WBE participation levels.
requirements.text: List all certified M/WBEs solicited from the NYS Directory of Certified Firms.

requirements.quote: 5. Copies of notices, dates of contact, letters, and other correspondence as proof that solicitations were made in writing and copies of such solicitations, or a sample copy of the solicitation if an identical solicitation was made to all certified M/WBEs.
requirements.text: Provide proof of written solicitations to certified M/WBEs.

requirements.quote: 6. Provide copies of responses made by certified M/WBEs to your solicitations.
requirements.text: Submit copies of responses from certified M/WBEs to solicitations.

requirements.quote: 7. Provide a description of any contract documents, plans, or specifications made available to certified M/WBEs for purposes of soliciting their bids and the date and manner in which these documents were made available.
requirements.text: Describe contract documents provided to certified M/WBEs for bid solicitation.

requirements.quote: 8. Provide documentation of any negotiations between you, the Offeror/Contractor, and the M/WBEs undertaken for purposes of complying with the certified M/WBE participation goals.
requirements.text: Submit documentation of negotiations with M/WBEs for participation goals.

requirements.quote: 9. Provide any other information you deem relevant which may help us in evaluating your request for a waiver.
requirements.text: Include any additional relevant information for waiver evaluation.

requirements.quote: 10. Provide the name, title, address, telephone number, and email address of offeror/contractor’s representative authorized to discuss and negotiate this waiver request.
requirements.text: Provide contact details of the representative authorized to discuss the waiver.

requirements.quote: 11. Copy of notice of application receipt issued by Empire State Development (ESD).
requirements.text: Submit a copy of the application receipt notice from ESD.

requirements.quote: Unless a Total Waiver has been granted, Offeror/Contractor will be required to submit all reports and documents pursuant to the provisions set forth in the Contract, as deemed appropriate by the contracting entity, to determine M/WBE compliance.
requirements.text: Submit all required reports and documents unless a Total Waiver is granted.
